claims.text: Hawthorn reported completion of the merger.

citation.quote: On September 4, 2026, HBI issued a press release announcing the completion of the Merger, a copy of which is attached to this Current Report on Form 8-K as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated herein by reference.

claims.text: FBI merged into HBI, with HBI surviving the transaction.

citation.quote: Immediately following the First Step Merger and as part of the same overall transaction, FBI merged with and into HBI, with HBI continuing as the surviving corporation (the “Second Step Merger,” and together with the First Step Merger, the “Merger”).

claims.text: FBI common shareholders received 413,101 HBI shares and $13,953,000 in cash.

citation.quote: The total aggregate consideration delivered to holders of FBI common stock was (i) 413,101 shares of HBI common stock, (ii) $13,953,000 in cash, and (iii) cash in lieu of any fractional shares.

claims.text: Hawthorn says deterioration in local economic and real estate conditions would adversely affect the company and bank’s financial condition.

citation.quote: The financial condition of both the Company and the Bank would be adversely affected by deterioration in the general economic and real estate climate in our markets.
